summary: The note briefly states that Ancient Egypt has extensive evidence of breadmaking. The evidence takes three forms: artistic depictions, remains of structures and tools used in bread making, and preserved remains of dough and bread itself. The note is a short stub with no further detail.
one_line: Overview noting that extensive archaeological and artistic evidence documents breadmaking in Ancient Egypt.
key_facts: There is extensive evidence of breadmaking in Ancient Egypt.
Evidence of Ancient Egyptian breadmaking includes artistic depictions.
Evidence of Ancient Egyptian breadmaking includes remains of structures used in bread making.
Evidence of Ancient Egyptian breadmaking includes remains of items used in bread making.
Evidence of Ancient Egyptian breadmaking includes remains of the dough and bread itself.
